description: Profit-hunting lane keeps small but interesting pockets for diagnosis; not acceptance.

Exploratory candidates may enter the ledger if base-cost net is positive.
Side-flip, random-side and shuffled-label controls are recorded for exploratory ranking but do not suppress discovery rows.
Acceptance-grade candidate must have enough events before replay or promotion discussion.
Acceptance-grade candidate must not be a one-name or four-name artifact.
Current training data has one date; future unseen date expansion must raise this floor.
Acceptance lane base cost stack must be positive.
Acceptance lane 1.5x modeled Zerodha cost stress must be positive.
Acceptance lane 2x modeled Zerodha cost stress must be positive.
Acceptance lane rejects tiny residual 2x edges such as Phase265's about 4.21 INR/event.
Acceptance lane must beat shuffled-label net P&L by an economically material margin.
Acceptance lane requires flipped signal side to degrade net P&L.
Acceptance lane requires deterministic random-side beat.
L1-only candidate is forbidden in both lanes.
